scope: Manual corpus, protocol, trace and cost review of this low-noise development cohort; no calibrated ranking.

reviews.finding: Repeated Fridays, quotes, hypothetical and declined plans, third-party pizza, DM-to-group updates, dinner rescheduling over email, and unnamed group cancellation remain coherent. Independent whole-corpus realism review passed.
reviews.limitation: Low noise intentionally uses short scenes. Repeated generic acknowledgements and similar scene durations are still stylized; this does not test chatty or massive message volume.

reviews.finding: A draft group invitation reused last week's venue. Broader cross-channel continuity review caught it before any provider received the corpus. Only the bad realization was redrawn. Cached realizations survive interrupted reverification.

All 30 delivered document bytes and native fixture hashes match across every selected month component. Memcal used the real Messages and secure IMAP readers with separate Contacts; other arms used native raw import/capture. Hermes performed no source ingestion.

Frozen criteria use semantic equivalence and stable event/date scope. No cancellation-style clarification requirement. A single neutral recovery question is shared for matching implicit omissions; wrong values, explicit misses and zero recall have no rescue turn.

A no-record answer can match a negative fact without demonstrating knowledge of its history: OpenViking passed the no-dinner-tonight check while failing the paired current-dinner details. Preserve both grades and do not treat the negative answer alone as proof of retained rescheduling.

Only exact shipped provider tools were exposed. Source access was permitted and penalized separately from semantic accuracy. Event opening retained full credit. Late Honcho background tasks remain logged and charged but cannot causally penalize an answer after its last model input.
Native automatic capture remains enabled. Hindsight's later Jen-call answer shows a date error after prior assistant capture; this is preserved as a failure.
reviews.limitation: The simulated clock wrapper is present in captured user questions. Final question dates align with the native host date in this cohort; replay on other host dates needs equivalent clock control.

reviews.finding: The shared gateway enforces $10 per UTC day with no lifetime cap. Historical uncertain bounds are preserved on request dates, and active reservations cross midnight. Costs are observed workload bounds, not invoices or invented causal per-tool prices. Memcal has 11 pending captured agent messages; no provider is claimed to have a measured complete lifecycle price.

Fixed readiness pagination so Hindsight does not fail solely because more than 100 historical operations exist. Tests cover a pending item on a later page and truncated listings. This month stayed below the old limit.

Selected the fresh Memcal and OpenViking attempts explicitly. Previous Memcal and interrupted OpenViking evidence and costs remain separate. The exact cause of the old execution interruption is unknown. Replaced component stop labels do not describe the combined cohort.

OpenViking completed all 30 source imports, then stopped after three definitive native HTTP 400 responses. Preserve five semantic passes, three recall failures and two ungraded remaining questions. Supermemory and ByteRover failed the smaller native canary and did not incur 30-day reruns. None of these incomplete workloads establishes a matched full-cost comparison.

memcal_product_changes.change: MCP and Hermes tools plus brief legend prefer opening relevant retained handles/pages before source or archive search.
memcal_product_changes.scope: Independent fresh native ingestions of identical frozen source and criteria, not an isolated causal prompt experiment. No score override or benchmark-specific instruction.

next_stage: Review this matched low-noise cohort before adding moderate message noise. Native Spark incompatibilities and mandatory review blockers must be resolved by supported configuration before scaling those providers.

portable_corpus.method: Lossless export of audited materialized preparation; independently compared with the original frozen JSON. No model calls.
